description: Provision an AWS Ec2 TransitGatewayVPCAttachment via the ACK ec2 controller. Fields mirror the ec2.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1 TransitGatewayVPCAttachment spec.

region.description: AWS region for this resource (e.g. eu-west-1). Rendered as the services.k8s.aws/region annotation. Empty inherits the ACK controller's default region.
region.title: AWS region

subnetIDs.description:
The IDs of one or more subnets. You can specify only one subnet per Availability
Zone. You must specify at least one subnet, but we recommend that you specify
two subnets for better availability. The transit gateway uses one IP address
from each specified subnet.

tags.description:
The tags. The value parameter is required, but if you don't want the tag
to have a value, specify the parameter with no value, and we set the value
to an empty string.
